statements.quote: The soil is clean, the oversight is independent, and the Cycle 115 review holds — the fence answers within 48 hours, and the trucks run quiet.
statements.fullStatement: Baylight Authority Director Keisha Ramos confirmed Phase II remediation continues on schedule with independent oversight verified, and the Cycle 115 construction milestone review stands. Effective this cycle, the construction hotline is live — the number on the fence now routes directly to our community response desk with a 48-hour guaranteed answer. Dust control is active on all haul routes serving the 65-acre site, and I've moved the workforce coordination meeting with Jack London businesses up into this cycle so the neighborhoods beside the build hear our labor plan before the C115 review, not after. This is a $2.1 billion project on a project clock — and a project only succeeds if the people living next to it hold too.
